body.name: Assigned source in a law completion
body.construction: For \(\widetilde{\mathcal M}\in\mathfrak F_x^{\mathrm{law}}(P_X)\) and \(i\in\mathsf O\), define \(s_{\widetilde{\mathcal M}}^{\mathrm{law}}(i)\) to be the unique \(k\in\{1,\ldots,m_{\widetilde{\mathcal M}}\}\) such that \(H^{\widetilde{\mathcal M}}_{ik}\ne0\).
